description: Register a product image so it can appear, consistently, across generated video ads. Pass an image URL (or data URI); it is stored permanently and returns a product_id to use with studio_generate. No render charge.

image_url.description: An http(s) URL or data:image/ URI of the product photo

name.description: A label for your reference, e.g. "AURA Tumbler 40oz"

prompt_fragment.description: Short phrase describing the product, injected into the ad prompt, e.g. "a matte-black AURA tumbler with a handle"

name: studio_register_product
title: Register a product for ads
